verdict.rationale: YYLO supports repetition and reusable workflows: `yy loop` repeats shell commands sequentially, contracts can be saved as reusable YAML workflows, and Run-Until-Completion repeats bounded iterations until kanban work is done. Nothing in the evidence shows time-based or recurring scheduling (cron-like triggers or schedule definitions), so users would need an external scheduler to run jobs on a cadence. Missing for 10: native time-based/cron scheduling of jobs or workflows, schedule management (list/pause/edit), documentation of recurring triggers, independent corroboration.
